item.title: Three Dog Night's Chuck Negron, voice behind 'Joy to the World,' dies at 83
item.description: A founding member of the rock band Three Dog Night has died.

item.title: Stamkos scores twice in 3rd in Predators' 6-5 comeback win over Blues
item.description: Steven Stamkos scored twice in the third period to help the Nashville Predators rally for a 6-5 victory over the St. Louis Blues on Monday night.

item.title: Asian shares surge as markets regain momentum after recent volatility
item.description: Asian shares have surged, led by a 5% jump in South Korea's benchmark.

item.title: Ryan Donato scores twice as the Blackhawks beat the Sharks 6-3
item.description: Ryan Donato had two goals and two assists, and the Chicago Blackhawks beat the San Jose Sharks 6-3.

item.title: Pressed into service, goalie Clay Stevenson has delivered 2 important wins for Washington
item.description: Clay Stevenson made 29 saves, helping Washington to a 4-1 victory over the New York Islanders.

item.title: Thomas Harley scores in OT as Stars beat Jets 4-3 for 5th straight win
item.description: Thomas Harley scored at 2:05 of overtime, and the Dallas Stars matched their longest winning streak of the season at five games with a 4-3 victory over the Winnipeg Jets.

item.title: Seahawks' Klint Kubiak focused on Super Bowl, not Raiders job
item.description: Seattle Seahawks offensive coordinator Klint Kubiak said his entire focus this week is on beating the New England Patriots in the Super Bowl and not on a future that is expected to land him a job as head coach of the Las Vegas Raiders.

item.title: Darryn Peterson hits two late 3s as No. 11 Kansas wins 64-61 at No. 13 Texas Tech
item.description: Kansas freshman Darryn Peterson scored 19 points, including two 3-pointers in the final 1:20 for his only field goals of the second half, and the 11th-ranked Jayhawks overcame a late nine-point deficit to beat No. 13 Texas Tech 64-61.

item.title: Gibson and Raymond power Red Wings to a 2-0 victory over the Avalanche
item.description: John Gibson stopped 21 shots for his fourth shutout of the season and Lucas Raymond scored and had his team-leading 41st assist as the Detroit Red Wings beat the Colorado Avalanche 2-0.

item.title: Gateway Development Commission sues Trump administration over stalled federal funds for Hudson River tunnel
item.description: The lawsuit seeks more than $205 million in funding owed to the project.
